tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha snyan brgyud zab mo'i skor las: lo ma can gyi gtor sgrub zin bris gsal bar bkod pa bzhugs so:
ྈྈྈ na mo par+ṇa sha ba rī ye/ 'phags ma ri khrod ma la phyag 'tshal nas// de yi gtor sgrub man ngag gsal bkod bya// lha mo nyid kyis bka' gnang byin gyis rlobs//

dus ngan snyigs ma bsod nams mar 'grib dus// du ru ka yi dmag tshogs sde lnga 'byung*// de yi nang nas nad kyi du ru ka /bka' dang bstan bcos gzhung nas ma grags pa'i// 'gos nad mang po dar bas mi thog 'bud// nad rtags me chu go log ston pa'i phyir// rtsi sman cis kyang mi phan dug tu 'gro /de dag srung dang zlog dang zhi ba'i thabs// lo ma gyon ma'i sgrub thabs tshem pa lnga// gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha las byung ba// gcig tu dril nas nyams su len pa'i thabs// li lder shing sogs zhi ba'i snod kyi nang*// gtor ma lnga po dpe 'u ris ltar bca'// de la tsaka li bdun pa dpe'u ris ltar// ma nor gtor ma so sor btsugs la bsham// shog gu gtsang mar nad bdag liṅga ni// mngon rtogs nang nas 'byung ba lta bur bris// gzhung ltar 'gugs gzhug mang du byas nas kyang*// them 'og gam ni 'og phyogs lam la mnan// steng du rdo leb rdo rje rgya gram mnan// rgyun du 'don dus de la mnan dmigs bya// gal te mnan pa la sogs ma grub kyang*// dmigs pa kho na byas pas chog pa yin// dpon slob mang na brgya tshar la sogs pa'am// gcig pu yin na zhag 'ga' sgrub pa byed// sgrub pa ma thon na'ang tshar mang 'don// glo bur tsaka li gtor ma ma 'dzom kyang*// zlum gtor lnga tshom gcig la bton kyang rung*// tshar grangs ci 'grub bton rjes rang don la// gtor ma de yis bdag 'jug dbang yang blang*// grwa slob yon bdag la sogs gal chen la// gtor ma de yis rjes gnang spyi ltar bya// bdag 'jug dbang bskur grub bam ma grub rung*// gtor ma bsrung bya kun gyis dngos 'grub rol// dngos gzhi cho ga 'di nyid 'don sgom sbrags//

na mo: dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum: skyabs gnas rnams la skyabs su mchi: 'gro ba'i nad rim rgyun gcod phyir: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: ka dag klong nas sprul pa yi: gnam sa gang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin: dkar gsum mngar gsum sman gyi mtsho: zad med gyur cig pū dza ho: bdag dang mdun du lo ma can: ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub: rma bya lo ma'i sham thabs can: pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs: mdun bskyed zhabs 'og shing lo ma: ljang mo khro mo'i cha lugs rdzogs: zla ba phyed pa'i dbu rgyan can: phyag na chu shel zhags pa 'dzin: rta ljang bcibs nas wa mo khrid: gtso 'khor gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum: thugs ka'i paṃ las 'od 'phros pas: sangs rgyas kun gyi byin rlabs rnams: bdag mdun thim zhing dbang bskur gyur:
ྈ rgya rgya rgya ma:

hūm̐: 'og min zhing dang mdangs dga' yi: ri khrod la sogs bzhugs gnas nas: lo ma gyon ma gshegs su gsol: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams na: mchod pa'i rnam pa ci mchis dang: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul: nad rnams ma lus 'joms byed cing: gdon kun tsit+ta sreg byed ma: nad rims kun 'joms rdo rje ste: lo ma gyon mar phyag 'tshal bstod: bdag dang bsrung bya thams cad kyi: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi sol: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: snyigs ma'i nad kyi bskal pa las: khyod kyis srung zhing skyabs mdzod cig:
ྈ ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ

ka ba rnam dag byang chub sems ma'i lus: kha nas hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis dgra bo brlag: gang na bzhugs kyang bdag la thugs rjes gzigs: nga yi bar chad thams cad da sol cig: ca le co le mang po ma mdzad cig: chab chob ma mdzad bdag la sku ston cig: ja chang phud kyis khyed ni rtag tu mchod: nya ma la sogs bdag gi 'khor rnams kyis: te te mi byed khyed la gsol ba 'debs: thal chen rak+ta zhag gi zo ris brgyan: don rnams 'grub mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo: na ba lta bu'i rta pho 'chib nas byon: par kha brgyad dang bcas pa zlog tu gsol: pha ma'i ring nas khyed la gsol ba btab: ba gcig yod na'ang khyed la bsngos nas bzhag: ma mo khyed ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: gtsug na zla ba phyed pas rab tu brgyan: tsha ba 'joms pa'i chu shel g.yas na bsnams: dza 'ag ti yi zhags pa g.yon na bsnams: wa mo khrid nas mtshan gyi gung la rgyug: zha bo'i lag nas byung ba'i dbyug pa yod: zab ber ngur smrig na bza' bdag la yod: 'a 'ag ta yi 'bras bu bdag la yod: yo 'gul med pa'i bsnyen pa bdag gis bgyid: ra dkar ba mo'i 'o zho bdag la yod: la chen rgyab na'ang khyed la gsol ba 'debs: shi na ma gtogs khyed la gsol ba 'debs: sa cha ga na yod kyang thugs rjes zungs: ha ka sa la ma phog bdag la yod: ā li kā li ci thon brjod cing yod:
ā li kā li ci thon brjod: dag po brjod ma shes na bris nas bzhag yod pas chog /

bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: oṃ las gtor ma bdud rtsi'i mtsho: kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs: lha mo dpon g.yog mnyes byed gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrī: oṃ pi shā tsi swā hā: i daṃ ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi:
gsum/
oṃ pi shā tsi raṃ khaṃ ye swā hā: i daṃ ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi:
gsum/

shar gyi gtor ma me tog can: nyer spyod kun la sogs pa yi: zhi ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'dis: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad mchod: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ba lin+ta khā hi pū tsa ho: hūm̐: lha min mi las g.yul rgyal nas: lha rnams ma dga' g.yul gtug byas: lha rnams lha min g.yul rgyal nas: lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa ni: rims nad zhi phyir mchod pa 'bul: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad mchod: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas de rnams la: bden pa chen po yod dam med: bden po chen po yod gyur na: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas de rnams kyi: mthu dang bden pa chen po yis: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi: rims nad thams cad zhi bar mdzod: gal te bden pa med na ni: sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs ni: cung zad tsam yang med pa min: de phyir rims ngan zhi bar mdzod: oṃ oṃ oṃ: sa ma ya: dz+wa ra shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: nub kyi gtor ma gri gug can: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la sogs: dbang gi mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'dis: phyogs bcu dus drug sangs rgyas mchod: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bha lin+ta khā hi pū dza hūm̐: hūm̐: phyogs bcu dus ni drug dang bcas: de dus sangs rgyas thams cad byon: de dus byon pa'i sangs rgyas rnams: bden pa yod med da lta 'o: sangs rgyas khyod kyi bden pa'i mthus: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi:

rims ngan 'di ni zhi bar mdzod: ma yengs ma 'khrul da gson cig: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas rnams: dus ngan snyigs ma 'di yi dus: tshe la rku ba'i nad ngan 'dug: srog la 'jab pa'i nad ngan 'dug: sku la bsdo ba'i nad ngan 'dug: 'di rnams thams cad zhi bar mdzod: gal te zhi bar ma byas na: phyogs bcu dus drug sangs rgyas de: rnams la bden pa med pa yin: a a ā: sa ma ya: dz+wa ra shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā:
lho yi/

gtor ma gru bzhi yu ba can: rgyal srid bdun la sogs pa yi: rgyas pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'dis: dus drug phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mchod: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ba lin+ta khā hi pū dza ho: hūm̐: bdud dang lha gnyis g.yul gtugs nas: de dus lha rnams g.yul rgyal dus: lha mo rnams kyis phyogs bcu yi: sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa ni: dus drug tu ni mchod pa byas: sangs rgyas rnams kyang de dus mnyes: de dus nad rims bsal pa bzhin: da yang bdag gi nad rims sol: bden pa i 'dug da lta 'o: dus ngan snyigs mar skyes pa yi: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la: rims ngan btsog mo 'di nyid kyis: bla ma'i sku la bsdos su btsugs: de la bden pa med pa 'am: yod na rims ngan da zhi mdzod: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: sa ma ya: dz+wa ra shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: byang gi gtor ma zur gsum can: drag po'i mchod sprin dpag med pa: khro bo khro mo thams cad dang: ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad mchod: oṃ sarba kro dha dhā ki de wī bha lin+ta khā hi pū dza ho: lo ma'i sham thabs smad du gsol: ma mo thams cad dbang du sdud: ce spyang gzugs can nad bdag mo: khyod kyis dbang du sdus gyis la: nad kun zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: mdun gyi 'og tu sa yi dong: kha dog mthil yangs thar med nang: ce spyang gzugs la mche bzhi yi: brang mdor sleb cing skra mtshams sleb:
nu gnyis g.yas g.yon gru mo'i thad: bslebs te tshon dru nad rkyal gnyis:
nad rkyal/
phrag la khur zhing
gru gu/

lag tu thogs: shin tu 'jigs pa'i mig gnyis la: long long dpung gnyis hūm̐ dzaḥdang: kha nang mā ra ya khrad dang: mgrin pa'i g.yas dang g.yon gnyis la: zhon zhon gru mor chag chag gi: yig 'bru dang bcas gsal bar gyur: dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum: ri khrod ma dang shing lo ma'i: bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs kyis: bdag cag rnams la gnod pa yi: nad 'dre rims kyi sna 'dren kun: nad bdag ce spyang gzugs la khug: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dbyer med gyur: hūm̐: bdud dang lha rnams g.yul gtugs dus: de dus lha pham bdud rgyal nas: sangs rgyas rnams la bar chad byas: de dus thams cad skrag cing 'dar: nyi ma zla ba thang la brul: sangs rgyas rnams kyis bdud ma thul: de ltar byas na bden pa med: gal te bden pa yod gyur na: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi: rims nad thams cad zhi bar mdzod: bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshigs pa dang: dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad pa dang: gsang sngags chos la sdang ba dang: sde dgon yo byad rku ba dang: bsam gtan pa yi sems dkrug dang: skye bo sdig la dga' ba dang: dge ba sdig la sgyur byed pa'i: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bo ni: thams cad 'di yi lus la tshang: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: de dus bdud rnams btul pa bzhin: rims ngan 'di ni da thul cig: hrīḥhrīḥhrī: sa ma ya: sarba dz+wa ra phaṭa:

ce spyang gzugs can nad bdag mo: rim dgu'i sa yi 'og tu song: de steng rlung me chu sa dang: ri rab gling bzhi bcas pas non: oṃ pi shā tsi swā hā: sarba dz+wa ra mā ra ya s+t+wam+bha ya na sha ya: oṃ lam hūm̐ lam s+t+wam+bha ya nan: bdag mdun lha mo'i thugs ka nas: paṃ mthar sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor: rang gi thugs las 'od 'phros pas: rang 'dra'i lha mo ye shes pa: dpag med spyan drangs bdag mdun thim: sprul pa'i lha mos nam mkha' gang: bar snang sa gzhi thams cad gang: sku las ye shes me chen 'bar: nad rims yams nad thams cad ni: bya sgro me la bsregs ltar gyur: oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha ba rī sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma ni swā hā:
ces bzlas bsnyen pa ci 'grub dang*/

shing lo ma yi thugs ka ru: paṃ mthar sngags phreng g.yon 'khor dang: phyag gi chu shel 'od zer gyis: nam mkha' bar snang lha mo bskul: de dag sku las bdud rtsi ni: sman gyi char rgyun char babs pas: nad rims yams nad thams cad dag: bde stong nyams rtogs 'bar bar gyur: oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha ba rī sarba raṃ khaṃ pra ma ye swā hā: sprul pa'i lha mo bdag mdun thim: mdun bskyed lo ma gyon ma yi: phyag g.yas rdo rje de nyid las: 'od zer nyi 'od char ltar du: 'phros pas 'od zer de nyid ni: gang phog nad kyis mi tshugs gyur: oṃ pi shā tsi swā hā: oṃ pi tsi raṃ khaṃ ye swā hā: badz+ra rak+ṣa ku ru ye swā hā:

bsnyen pa ci 'grub bzlas pa'i rjes// gso bran byas pas chog pa ste// brgya rtsa man nas gsum bdun yan// ci 'grub rtags dang bstun pas chog /'di skabs gzhan la dbang bskur na// rgyas par rjes gnang spyi ltar te// bsdu na bdag 'jug yig chung de// bton pas dbang bskur tshang ba ste// gal chen yin na gsum bdun zhig /bdag 'jug yig chung mi dgos te//
mdun bskyed bla ma dbyer med
bsam//
sa gzhi spos
sogs/
gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas dang: slob dpon lo ma can rnams la: gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur stsol:
ces lan gsum/

dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don gnyis rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /
ces brjod/

de nas khyed rang rnams kyis mos pa 'di ltar sgoms shig /gtor ma 'di dang slob dpon gnyis ka lo ma can: ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub: rma bya lo ma'i sham thabs can: pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs: mdun bskyed zhabs 'og shing lo ma: ljang mo khro mo'i cha lugs rdzogs: zla ba phyed pa'i dbu rgyan can: phyag na chu shel zhags pa 'dzin: rta ljang bcibs nas wa mo khrid: gtso 'khor gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum: thugs ka'i paṃ las 'od 'phros pas: sangs rgyas kun gyi byin rlabs rnams: bdag mdun thim zhing dbang bskur gyur:
ces gong gi mngon rtogs ltar bsgom la/
dbang gtor khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag pa'i tshe/ gtor ma lo ma can dang*/ slob dpon gnyis ka'i byin rlabs zhugs par gyur par sgoms shig /
ces gtor ma mgor bzhag /

hūm̐: 'og min zhing dang mdangs dga' yi: ri khrod la sogs bzhugs gnas nas: lo ma gyon ma gshegs su gsol: dbang skur byin gyis brlab tu gsol: lo ma'i sham thabs smad du gsol: ma mo thams cad dbang du sdud: ce spyang gzugs can nad bdag mo: khyod kyis dbang du sdus gyis la: nad kun zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: bdag dang bsrung bya thams cad kyi: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi sol: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: snyigs ma'i nad kyi bskal pa las: khyod kyis srung zhing skyabs mdzod cig: oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha ba rī sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma ni swā hā: oṃ par+ṇa sha ba rī swā hā: oṃ pi shā tsi swā hā: oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha wa rī sarba raṃ khaṃ pra sha ma na ye swā hā: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐:
sngags lan bdun brjod/
nad rnams ma lus 'joms byed cing: gdon kun tsit+ta sreg byed ma: nad rims kun 'joms rdo rje ste: lo ma gyon ma'i bkra shis shog:
me tog 'thor ro//
de nas lo ma gyon ma 'di nyid yi dam du gzung snyams pas rjes zlos gyis shig /gtso bos ji ltar bka'
sogs/
sa gzhi spos chus

sogs/ rang la tshad ru la sogs kyi// rims nad 'tshe ba mang ba la// 'di yi cho ga bdag 'jug bcas// brgya rtsa blangs na shin tu phan// gal chen gzhan la'ang de dang mtshungs// lo ma can dang shing lo ma// gnyis ka'i sgrub pa tshang 'dod na// cho ga 'di nyid dus bzhir gtang*// rgyun du thun mgor lo ma can// thun mjug shing lo ma nyid bsnyen// rtags ni lha mo spyi dang mtshungs// sman dang chu shel rnyed pa rmis// mtshams ni grol kha bdag 'jug blang*// sgrub pa'am ni dbang bskur mjug /

ri khrod ma dang shing lo mar: thugs la 'gal ba thams cad bshags: phyag 'tshal mchod cing bstod par bgyi: g.yog mo 'od zhu dpon mor thim: lha mo ye shes rang la thim: dam tshig lha mo gtor mar thim: bdag nyid mtha' nas dbus su yal: rgyal ba'i yum gyi dgongs pa rtogs: dge bas 'gro ba'i nad kun zhi: bde skyid ldan pa'i bkra shis shog:

ces pa 'di ni sa phyogs su// stod smad kun nas rims nad dar// phog nas mi thar 'chi 'dug phyir// ro khur ba rnams nad med kyang*// gson la snyung ba'i dus ngan byung*// de tshe rā ga a s+ya yis// lha mo nyid la gsol btab pas// 'di nyid bsgrigs na phan che ste// thengs chog yin gsungs lung bstan byung*// de phyir chu pho byi ba'i lo// dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes bcur bsgrigs// yi ge dge ba'i ming gis bris// tsaka li bca' tshogs dpe'u ris ltar ro// maṅga laṃ/// /
